nodes.name: nba_stats_lineups.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats API lineup and matchup endpoints (leaguedashlineups, leaguelineupviz, leagueplayerondetails, leagueseasonmatchups, matchupsrollup, fantasywidget), returning tidy data frames of five-man lineup and head-to-head matchup statistics.
nodes.languageNotes: Each exported wrapper builds a stats.nba.com query string and parses the resultSets JSON into a data frame via the shared NBA Stats helper.

nodes.name: nba_stats_pbp.R
nodes.summary: Core NBA play-by-play retrieval module exposing nba_playbyplayv3, nba_pbp/nba_pbps (multi-game), and the live cdn.nba.com feeds nba_live_pbp and nba_live_boxscore; assembles enriched per-event play-by-play frames.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest PBP module in the batch; combines the classic stats endpoint with live JSON feeds and uses progressr for multi-game progress reporting.

nodes.name: nba_stats_player_dash.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats player-dashboard family (by clutch, game splits, general splits, last-N games, opponent, shooting splits, team performance, year-over-year) plus the player-tracking dashboards (pt pass/reb/shots/shotdefend), returning split player statistics.

nodes.name: nba_stats_player.R
nodes.summary: Largest player-data module: wraps NBA Stats player endpoints including playerindex, career stats, game logs, awards, fantasy profiles, estimated metrics, and the cdn.nba.com player headshot helper; several legacy endpoints are lifecycle-deprecated.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the lifecycle package to mark unstable/empty endpoints deprecated in hoopR 3.0.0 while keeping the canonical replacements live.

nodes.name: nba_stats_roster.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats common-info endpoints (commonallplayers, commonplayerinfo, commonplayoffseries, commonteamroster, commonteamyears), providing league player directories, individual bios, playoff series, and team roster tables.

nodes.name: nba_stats_scoreboard.R
nodes.summary: Provides NBA schedule and scoreboard access (nba_schedule, scoreboard/scoreboardv2/scoreboardv3, todays_scoreboard, winprobabilitypbp, scheduleleaguev2int) drawing on both the cdn.nba.com schedule feed and the stats.nba.com scoreboard endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: Older scoreboard versions are lifecycle-deprecated in favor of nba_scoreboardv3().

nodes.name: nba_stats_shotchart.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats shot-chart endpoints (shotchartdetail, shotchartleaguewide, shotchartlineupdetail), returning per-shot location and make/miss data for players, the league, and lineups.

nodes.name: nba_stats_team_dash.R
nodes.summary: Team-side counterpart to the player dashboards: wraps the NBA Stats team-dashboard family (clutch, game/general/last-N/opponent/shooting splits, team performance, year-over-year) plus team lineups and player-tracking dashboards.

nodes.name: nba_stats_team.R
nodes.summary: Largest team-data module: wraps NBA Stats team endpoints including teams, teamdetails, estimated metrics, game logs, historical leaders, info-common, player on/off details, year-by-year stats, and team-vs-player splits.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses lifecycle to deprecate legacy team endpoints; draws team metadata from both cdn.nba.com and stats.nba.com.

nodes.name: nba_stats_video.R
nodes.summary: Wraps the NBA Stats video endpoints (videodetails/videodetailsasset, videoevents/videoeventsasset, videostatus), returning play video metadata and asset URLs tied to game events.

nodes.name: nba_stats.R
nodes.summary: Overview/index module for the NBA Stats API surface, documenting the stats.nba.com endpoint families and serving as the conceptual entry point for the nba_stats_* wrapper modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains roxygen overview prose (no exported functions) cataloguing the endpoint groups implemented across the sibling nba_stats_* files.

nodes.name: nbadraft_mock_draft.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes NBADraft.net mock-draft tables via rvest and returns a tidy data frame of projected draft picks for a given draft year.

nodes.name: nbagl_pbp.R
nodes.summary: Retrieves NBA G-League play-by-play (nbagl_pbp) and live feeds (nbagl_live_pbp, nbagl_live_boxscore) by reusing the NBA Stats play-by-play pipeline against G-League game IDs.
nodes.languageNotes: Delegates parsing to the same JSON resultSets pipeline as nba_stats_pbp.R, parameterized for the G-League.

nodes.name: nbagl_players.R
nodes.summary: Retrieves the NBA G-League player index (nbagl_players) via the NBA Stats playerindex endpoint scoped to gleague.nba.com, returning a tidy player directory.

nodes.name: nbagl_schedule.R
nodes.summary: Retrieves the NBA G-League schedule (nbagl_schedule) from the data.nba.com schedule feed, returning a tidy season schedule with game dates and matchups.

nodes.name: nbagl_standings.R
nodes.summary: Retrieves current NBA G-League standings (nbagl_standings) via the NBA Stats standings feed on s.data.nba.com, returning a tidy team standings table.

nodes.name: ncaa_mbb_data.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes NCAA.com / stats.ncaa.org for men's college basketball NET rankings (ncaa_mbb_NET_rankings) and the Division I/II/III team directory (ncaa_mbb_teams) by year and division.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses xml2 + rvest for HTML table scraping with cli progress messaging.

nodes.name: realgm_draft.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com draft pages for historical draft results (realgm_draft) and early-entry candidate lists (realgm_early_entry), returning tidy draft data frames.

nodes.name: realgm_players.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com player pages for the player directory (realgm_players), players abroad (realgm_players_abroad), and future free agents (realgm_future_free_agents).

nodes.name: realgm_salaries.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com salary-cap pages for the league salary cap history (realgm_salary_cap) and the rookie scale tables (realgm_rookie_scale).

nodes.name: realgm_staff.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com staff pages for coaching staff (realgm_coaches) and general manager (realgm_gms) directories, returning tidy personnel tables.

nodes.name: realgm_standings.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com for league standings (realgm_standings) and the team directory (realgm_teams), returning tidy standings and team-lookup data frames.

nodes.name: realgm_stats.R
nodes.summary: Largest RealGM scraper: pulls player and team season stats, individual season/game logs, and draft-prospect stats (realgm_player_stats, realgm_team_stats, realgm_individual_seasons, realgm_individual_games, realgm_draft_prospects) from basketball.realgm.com.

nodes.name: realgm_transactions.R
nodes.summary: Scrapes basketball.realgm.com transaction pages via rvest (realgm_transactions), returning a tidy table of player signings, trades, and roster moves.

nodes.name: realgm_utils.R
nodes.summary: Shared internal helpers for the RealGM scrapers, providing chromote-driven page rendering, URL building, and rvest/janitor table-cleaning utilities consumed across the realgm_* modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses chromote for headless-browser rendering of JS-driven RealGM pages; no exported (top-level assigned) functions detected by the structural pass.
